Subject: Re: Intro + Demo — Cost/TCO recap & next steps

James — great to connect this afternoon. Below is a concise post-call TCO recap and proposed next steps. I attached a one-sheet (acme_tco_summary.xlsx) and our standard pricing proposal (redwood_pricing_proposal.pdf).

Quick summary of what we heard
- Workload: ~50M tokens/month (chat + nightly summaries).
- Constraints: target pilot spend ~ $4k/mo. Latency SLO: 95th < 600ms.

Redwood cost levers (how we get to lower spend)
1) Batching/throughput: continuous batching on serving layer can reduce per-token RPC overhead. From your distribution, we estimate ~12-18% unit improvement on chat tokens by grouping small concurrent requests into larger batches.
2) KV/prefix caching: your nightly summaries and many assistant flows reuse system prompts and data prefixes. With prefix/KV caching we expect to drop repeat token generation by ~20-25% on those flows.
3) Model tiering & fallback: route low-risk, high-volume inference (e.g., short summaries) to a smaller quantized variant (e.g., 7B int8) and keep 13B/70B variants for high-value queries. We model a further ~15-20% reduction in raw model compute spend.
4) Response control: truncation, stop-token policies and optimized prompt framing can trim average output length by ~10% without impacting downstream metrics in many cases.

Estimated impact (conservative) — baseline = your current usage (50M tokens)
- Baseline spend (your current provider): $6,000/mo (as you mentioned)
- Estimated savings from batching + caching + tiering + output controls: ~45% (conservative combined effect)
- Projected Redwood spend: $3,300/mo (post-levers)
- Pilot target: we can offer a pilot package to cap spend at $4,000/mo for the first quarter and run a 2-week sandbox to validate production SLOs and realized savings.

Pilot proposal & next steps
1) 2-week sandbox (no onboarding fee) — Redwood provides a preconfigured environment with: sample model routes, KV caching enabled, and SLO monitoring dashboards.
2) Cost simulation — we will run your anonymized request logs through our cost model and provide a per-token breakdown (estimates attached).
3) Technical kickoff — schedule a 60-min session with our Solutions Engineer to configure batching and caching thresholds (I recommend Rafael join).
4) Procurement — we’ll send a short PO-friendly proposal and a one-page SOW (see attached). If you confirm budget constraints ($4k/mo for Q1), we can commit to a pilot pricing cap.

Questions for you
- Can you confirm the 50M tokens/mo figure and the mix (approx % chat vs batch nightly jobs)?
- Any procurement timelines (PO windows) we should be aware of?

If that looks good I’ll loop in Rafael for the tech kickoff and send the pilot doc for signature.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
